Hi Michael — thanks for the agenda. Quick note on timezones: there is a DST oddity this month where US clocks moved forward before EU clocks, so the usual ET <-> CET offset is temporarily one hour different.

On our calendars Jonas and I are seeing your draft invite show up as 14:30 CET (which corresponds to 09:30 ET), so I suspect the invite tool defaulted to a 6-hour difference. For clarity, can you confirm you meant 08:30 Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) on Mon 16 Mar (which will be 13:30 Central European Time on the same day)?

If 08:30 ET is what you want, we can accept 08:30 ET / 13:30 CET. If you'd prefer a slightly later slot that avoids the DST ambiguity, we can do 11:00 ET / 16:00 CET. Either way we'll send an updated invite with explicit time zone markers and an .ics.

Proposed options (all Mon 16 Mar):
- Option A: 08:30 ET (13:30 CET) — good for US early morning, EU mid-afternoon
- Option B: 11:00 ET (16:00 CET) — a little later for US, late afternoon for EU

I'll hold both tentatively; let me know which you prefer and we will attach the agenda as a PDF.

Best,
